PERSONAL DATA PROTECTION ORDER, 2025 Notification of commencement In exercise of the power conferred by section 1(1) and (2) of the Personal Data Protection Order, 2025, the Minister of Transport and Infocommunications, with the consent of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby appoints 8th January 2025 as the date of commencement for the provisions of that Order as set out in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

PROVISIONS OF PERSONAL DATA PROTECTION ORDER, 2025

PART 1

PART2 PART 10 (excluding section 42)

PART 11

PART 12 SCHEDULE 6. Dated this 8th. day of Rejab, 1446 Hijriah corresponding to the 8th. day of January, 2025.

PENGIRAN DATO SERI SETIA SHAMHARY BIN PENGIRAN DATO PADUKA

HAJI MUSTAPHA Minister of Transport and Infocommunications.
